# 3407 Memorial

> A memorial and advocacy organization honoring the 50 victims of Continental Flight 3407 while championing aviation safety reforms and regulatory changes.

The 3407 Memorial represents families of those lost in the February 2009 crash of Continental Flight 3407 near Buffalo, New York. The organization has successfully advocated for major aviation safety legislation, including the Airline Safety and Federal Aviation Administration Extension Act of 2010 (PL 111-216), which established the 1500-hour pilot minimum flight time rule and other pilot qualification standards. The site documents their ongoing efforts to influence FAA leadership and aviation safety policy.
